messages_mentions_all_top_idx.name: messages_mentions_all_top_idx
messages_mentions_all_top_idx.where: "messages"."mentions_all" and "messages"."deleted_at" is null and "messages"."parent_id" is null

messages_mentions_all_reply_idx.name: messages_mentions_all_reply_idx
messages_mentions_all_reply_idx.where: "messages"."mentions_all" and "messages"."deleted_at" is null and "messages"."parent_id" is not null

finance_items_contract_check.name: finance_items_contract_check
finance_items_contract_check.value:
case when "finance_items"."type" = 'contract'
        then "finance_items"."amount_minor" is not null and "finance_items"."currency" is not null
          and "finance_items"."starts_on" is not null and "finance_items"."ends_on" is not null
        else "finance_items"."amount_minor" is null and "finance_items"."currency" is null and "finance_items"."starts_on" is null
          and "finance_items"."ends_on" is null and "finance_items"."contract_number" is null
        end

finance_time_entries_group_day_idx.name: finance_time_entries_group_day_idx
finance_time_entries_group_day_idx.where: "finance_time_entries"."minutes" is not null and "finance_time_entries"."worked_on" is not null

finance_time_entries_day_group_idx.name: finance_time_entries_day_group_idx
finance_time_entries_day_group_idx.where: "finance_time_entries"."minutes" is not null and "finance_time_entries"."worked_on" is not null

finance_time_entries_user_day_idx.name: finance_time_entries_user_day_idx
finance_time_entries_user_day_idx.where: "finance_time_entries"."minutes" is not null and "finance_time_entries"."worked_on" is not null

finance_time_entries_open_requests_idx.name: finance_time_entries_open_requests_idx
finance_time_entries_open_requests_idx.where: "finance_time_entries"."minutes" is null and "finance_time_entries"."worked_on" is not null

finance_time_entries_unit_idx.name: finance_time_entries_unit_idx
finance_time_entries_unit_idx.where: "finance_time_entries"."ticket_id" is not null or "finance_time_entries"."linked_ticket_id" is not null

finance_time_entries_subject_check.name: finance_time_entries_subject_check
finance_time_entries_subject_check.value:
case "finance_time_entries"."source"
        when 'task' then "finance_time_entries"."ticket_id" is null
        when 'ticket' then "finance_time_entries"."task_id" is null and "finance_time_entries"."linked_ticket_id" is null
        else "finance_time_entries"."task_id" is null and "finance_time_entries"."ticket_id" is null and "finance_time_entries"."linked_ticket_id" is null
        end

finance_time_entries_manual_check.name: finance_time_entries_manual_check
finance_time_entries_manual_check.value: "finance_time_entries"."source" <> 'manual' or ("finance_time_entries"."minutes" is not null and "finance_time_entries"."worked_on" is not null)

knowledge_items_chat_check.name: knowledge_items_chat_check
knowledge_items_chat_check.value: ("knowledge_items"."type" = 'chat_file') = ("knowledge_items"."chat_message_id" is not null) and ("knowledge_items"."chat_message_id" is null) = ("knowledge_items"."chat_file_id" is null) and ("knowledge_items"."chat_message_id" is null) = ("knowledge_items"."chat_channel_id" is null) and ("knowledge_items"."chat_message_id" is null) = ("knowledge_items"."chat_kind" is null)

notification_events_email_due_idx.name: notification_events_email_due_idx
notification_events_email_due_idx.where: "notification_events"."emailed_at" is null and "notification_events"."email_due_at" is not null
